title: Informal sector innovation in Ghana: data set and descriptive analysis
summary: The paper presents descriptive statistics from a 2016 survey of the innovations informal firms adopt or adapt in Accra and Tema. It finds that informal enterprises do innovate: their innovations are incremental rather than radical, occur over several years, and matter for their survival.
keyFindings: Their innovations are incremental, not radical, and occur over several years.
Incremental innovations are important to the survival of the sampled informal enterprises.
methods: 2016 survey of 513 informal enterprises in 17 randomly selected zones of Accra and Tema, using the World Bank Ghana Informal Enterprise Survey zones as the area frame.
